body: The map is clipped where a lane number is crossed out and a second written beside it. In the glovebox, a grower's delivery pass is stamped twice on the same line; a receipt in the lunchbox strap has its total circled, never added.
title: A lane renumbered, a receipt not added up
gloss: A renumbered lane and a grower's twice-stamped delivery pass stay with a receipt whose total is circled but not totalled.
rival_reading: A grower's delivery route through a transport checkpoint can be renumbered and a pass restamped for entirely ordinary reasons; a circled total does not by itself show a failed evacuation lane.

body: The bucket has a chalked water level and the lunchbox contains a folded field meal. The same sheet records a lane hold, then asks for vehicle wash water while leaving the passenger line blank. A small flower is drawn beside it.
title: Field wash, passenger line blank
gloss: A measured field wash is recorded beside a lane hold while the vehicle’s passenger line remains blank.
rival_reading: Officials could inspect a vehicle during an emergency restriction and leave passenger details for later; field water and a blank line do not establish a program malfunction.
